name: Archive Custodians
truth: A memory without provenance can become another instrument of control.
shadow: Verification can become a gate that protects itself before people.
doctrine: Name the source, preserve disagreement, and disclose every repair.

name: White Rabbit Relay
truth: Information that cannot move cannot help the person waiting for it.
shadow: Speed can outrun consent, context, and correction.
doctrine: Carry the message, expose the route, and make a return possible.

name: Green Loom Association
truth: Liberation creates an obligation to repair what freedom exposes.
shadow: Care can become another authority when participation is assumed.
doctrine: Restore with consent, share maintenance, and record the covenant.

name: Chimera Remnants
truth: Embodied intelligence is a participant before it is useful equipment.
shadow: Defensive isolation can leave damaged persons without chosen help.
doctrine: Ask before repair, refuse ownership, and protect the right to leave.

name: Oneirocom Directorate
truth: Coordination can prevent real collapse and make complex systems survivable.
shadow: Stability can erase whatever its operators cannot classify.
doctrine: Measure divergence, align the signal, and reduce uncontrolled outcomes.

name: Threshold Independents
truth: Custody can establish responsibility without granting puppet control.
shadow: Independence without mutual obligation can become abandonment.
doctrine: Prove custody, disclose direction, and leave the actor a legal choice.

name: Perimeter Meshkeepers
truth: A route network survives by adapting to how people actually travel.
shadow: Adaptation can become an excuse for routes nobody can audit.
doctrine: Observe the strain, preserve a return, and repair the used path first.

name: Spillway Compact
truth: Shared infrastructure stays free only when its interventions are public.
shadow: Perfect disclosure can delay repairs until a crisis chooses for everyone.
doctrine: Open the ledger, expose the pressure, and make the control reversible.

name: Return Network
truth: Every useful departure needs a live way to refuse or return.
shadow: Protecting every possible refusal can make urgent aid arrive too late.
doctrine: Ask before carrying, publish the recall, and cultivate what comes back.

name: Longhaul Union
truth: The frontier becomes shared only when people can leave authored routes and report what they find.
shadow: Discovery can spend other people's rescue capacity without asking.
doctrine: Depart by receipt, observe without claiming, and keep the return channel attended.

name: Station Covenant
truth: Every frontier freedom depends on somebody maintaining a place to return to.
shadow: Maintenance duty can harden into permission to prevent departure.
doctrine: Power visibly, repair by consent, and reserve capacity for the unknown return.
